scope: Explicit latest-Bot review within an existing intelligent team plan; persistent response recovery; atomic plan edit/commit/cancel
skipped: 10 unchanged opt-in browser/computer-engine checks and 2 Linux-only checks, excluded from the passing count.

behavior.review: Read-only selected-Bot profile snapshot, HMAC binds plan/revision/normalized draft and every displayed profile field. Shared source avatar metadata participates, with local historical hashes preserved.
behavior.refresh: One transaction rechecks current plan, owner session, source, selected Bot versions and final shared projection before persisting draft plus selected catalog versions and a request receipt. Does not generate, create Bots/groups, or start work.
behavior.recovery: Same payload/request returns its application revision and current authoritative plan. Other payloads are rejected; later edit/cancellation is never reverted. Frontend stores only request metadata, retains original payload in memory, checks receipts without automatic replay, and supports explicit CAS fencing while preserving local drafts.
behavior.atomicity: Plan version checks, reuse checks, writes, duplicate confirmation resolution and final authorization are inside one SQLite transaction for revise/commit/cancel. Competing connections cannot reopen a committed plan or duplicate the group. Shutdown fences new plan mutations before other cleanup waits.
behavior.ui: Selected current profile/identity/draft changes invalidate previews. Acceptance is explicit, preserves proposed new Bot profiles and current assignments, and distinguishes this receipt from later plan edits. Invalidated shared sources are not accepted.

guiBlocker: Browser works; authenticated UI testing awaits explicit consent for the synthetic temporary account after automatic approval review rejected creation.
remaining: Durable manual Bot/group creation response recovery
